basis: Fresh candidate Ghidra/P-Code comparison, exact AArch64 instruction and relocation parity, two reproducible Docker builds with identical module hashes, strict Joern scope with an explicit Assembly-only source-method exemption, KCFI parity, and host-helper coverage through the ioctl input-copy path.
limitations: This is static/offline function-level evidence; hardware behavior on NX809J remains unverified.
The helper is compiler-generated Assembly and therefore has no independent C method for Joern; this is recorded as an explicit, target-scoped exemption rather than inferred source semantics.
KCFI comparison is applicable and passes because both stock and candidate expose no valid KCFI preamble for this helper; no indirect-call proof is claimed.
The promotion does not claim that the remaining unpromoted fp_goodix functions are complete.
